items.a: A social padel format. Everyone plays short matches to a fixed number of points, and partners rotate every round. Your points add up individually, so by the end you've played with and against most of the group and there's a leaderboard to show for it.

items.q: I've never played padel. Can I come?
items.a: Yes. Look for games marked Beginner or All levels. Bring trainers with a flat sole; we can sort out a racket if you message us before the game.
No. Sign up on your own. Americano pairs you with someone new every round.

Book your spot here on the website. The host will message you on WhatsApp with the payment details, and your spot is confirmed once you pay. If you can't make it, cancel at least 24 hours before so someone on the waitlist can take your place.
Most sessions run 90 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the number of players and courts.
